originalTitle: Read everything that Nvidia’s board chair had to say about Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday was its first with CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress at the helm alongside the company's first board chair, Harvey C. Jones. content: Nvidia’s quarterly earnings call on Tuesday was its first with CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress at the helm alongside the company’s first board chair, Harvey C. Jones. The leadership change followed Jensen Huang’s resignation last week after reports he had multiple affairs – including one with former Megaspeed executive and alleged Chinese asset Alice Huang and one with a direct report, Kimberly Powell. Nvidia is investigating whether Huang’s relationship with the former compromised national security or company secrets. Huang will also testify before lawmakers on December 1st. Ahead of Tuesday’s earnings, Huang said he would be willing to return as CEO. However, during the company’s earnings call, Jones stated that “the Nvidia board unanimously accepted [Huang’s] resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO.” Jones also said that during the call, the company would not be addressing or taking questions “regarding the circumstances of Jensen’s resignation and the ongoing investigation.” He added that, “the Board is proactively dealing with the immediate consequences facing the company, as well as enhancing our oversight capacity going forward.” In Tuesday’s earnings Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, continuing years of skyrocketing revenue driven by the AI industry. Jones shared the following update on the company: > As Chairman of NVIDIA’s Board of Directors, I want to say a few words on the Board’s behalf. NVIDIA is an exceptionally strong company. Its strength comes from its extraordinary people, groundbreaking technology, and exemplary track record of execution. Our financial performance speaks for itself. > On November 12th, our Board of Directors announced that after disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company’s code of conduct, standards, and cultural norms, Jensen Huang voluntarily resigned his positions as President, CEO, and board member. The NVIDIA Board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO. The Board appointed Colette Kress, NVIDIA’s longtime and well-respected CFO, as interim CEO. In addition, the Board announced it was initiating a search for a permanent chief executive, and we have since retained Heidrick and Struggles to lead the search. > While this was an unexpected transition, the Board acted deliberately and in the best interest of the company’s employees, customers, partners, and shareholders. This morning, the company announced that our Board has established a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee that will include a select group of our independent Board directors, senior external advisors, and legal counsel. > This committee will enhance— will– excuse me, will enhance our engagement with the U.S. government, including all relevant agencies. We will not be addressing or taking questions on today’s call regarding the circumstances of Jensen’s resignation and the ongoing investigation. Our Board will communicate further when appropriate. On behalf of our shareholders, the Board is proactively dealing with the immediate consequences facing the company, as well as enhancing our oversight capacity going forward. > We have an incredibly talented leadership team, and we have every confidence in Colette’s leadership, integrity, and ability to deliver as interim CEO. Colette has been at the center of this company’s extraordinary growth for the last— growth for the last 13 years, instrumental in executing strategy, and with a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations, and financial position. The Board and the entire leadership team remain laser-focused on driving NVIDIA forward. Our commitment to generating value for shareholders, customers, and partners remains unchanged. Kress responded to a question about the company’s leadership transition, saying “the most important thing that we think through right now is our employees.” She added, “From a business perspective, it’s business as usual.” Jones also gave an update on Nvidia’s search for a new permanent CEO: > From the board’s point of view, we take the search very seriously. We’re going to look into internal candidates as well as external candidates. The Board appreciates that we’re living in a world where the advanced silicon technologies and national security dynamics are making major changes in our marketplace. Our new CEO will have to navigate those waters very carefully. So, the search will be thorough and we want to install the CEO, the permanent CEO, as quickly as possible, but we won’t expedite the CEO before finding exactly the right person.

chineseSummary: 周二，英伟达召开了由首席财务官兼临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 与公司首任董事会主席哈维·C·琼斯 (Harvey C. Jones) 共同主持的首次季度财报电话会议。领导层变动是在黄仁勋上周辞职后发生的，此前有报道称他有多起婚外情，其中包括与 Megaspeed 前高管和所谓的中国资产 Alice 的婚外情 […]
chineseContent: 英伟达周二召开的季度财报电话会议是由首席财务官兼临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 与公司首任董事会主席哈维·C·琼斯 (Harvey C. Jones) 共同主持的首次季度财报电话会议。黄仁勋上周辞职，此前有报道称他有多起婚外情，其中包括与 Megaspeed 前高管、所谓的中国资产爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的婚外情，以及与直接下属金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 的婚外情。英伟达正在调查黄与前者的关系是否损害了国家安全或公司机密。黄也将于 12 月 1 日在立法者面前作证。在周二的财报公布之前，黄仁勋表示他愿意重新担任首席执行官。然而，在公司财报电话会议上，琼斯表示，“英伟达董事会一致接受[黄的]辞职，并且不打算恢复詹森担任首席执行官。”琼斯还表示，在电话会议中，该公司不会回答或回答“有关詹森辞职的情况和正在进行的调查”的问题。他补充说，“董事会正在积极应对公司面临的直接后果，并增强我们未来的监督能力。”在周二的财报中，英伟达公布的季度收入为 1158 亿美元，在人工智能行业的推动下，收入持续多年飙升。 Jones 分享了公司的以下最新动态： > 作为 NVIDIA 董事会主席，我想代表董事会说几句话。 NVIDIA 是一家非常强大的公司。它的优势来自于其杰出的人才、突破性的技术和堪称典范的执行记录。我们的财务业绩不言而喻。 > 11月12日，我司董事会公告称，在披露与公司章程不符的个人行为后，
